query: CHP olağanüstü kurultay çağrı heyeti Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi başvuru karar - latest status as of late June / early July 2026. Has Özgür Özel's team filed the application under Civil Code Art 75 requesting appointment of a 3-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress? Has any court issued a decision?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**Yes, the application was filed — but not in late June/early July as the question framing suggests.** The key finding is a timing distinction:

- **The çağrı heyeti application to the Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi was filed on July 14, 2026** by Özgür Özel's team, requesting a 3-person call committee to convene a CHP extraordinary congress, based on Civil Code Art. 75, plus an interim-measure (tedbir) request.
- **No court decision has been issued yet** on this application as of mid-July 2026 — it was only just filed, with no reported hearing date or committee appointment.
- The underlying trigger: **833 delegates** (>2/3 of the total) submitted a notarized congress request on **June 17, 2026**, which the Kılıçdaroğlu-led leadership (restored after the "mutlak butlan" ruling) did not act on.
- **What happened in late June** was a *separate* matter: on **June 26, 2026**, the İstinaf (appellate court) rejected a "ruling clarification" application tied to Kılıçdaroğlu's injunction — not the Sulh Hukuk çağrı heyeti application.

So for forecasting purposes: **application FILED (July 14, 2026); court DECISION NOT YET ISSUED (as of mid-July 2026).**

key_facts: On July 14, 2026, Özgür Özel's team / opposition CHP delegates filed an application at the Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi requesting appointment of a 3-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress.
As of mid-July 2026, NO court decision has been issued on this çağrı heyeti application; no hearing date or committee appointment reported.
The application is based on Turkish Civil Code (Medeni Kanun) Article 75, the provision for court-appointed call committees when an association fails to convene a required general assembly.

833 kurultay delegates (more than two-thirds of total delegates) signed a notarized extraordinary congress request, submitted to CHP Genel Başkanlığı on June 17, 2026, within the bylaws' 15-day window.
The petition also requested an urgent interim measure (tedbir kararı) so the 3-member committee could begin work; the committee's powers would be limited solely to convening the congress.

A SEPARATE, earlier action: on June 26, 2026, the İstinaf (appellate court) rejected a 'karar açıklaması' (ruling clarification) application tied to Kılıçdaroğlu's injunction blocking the congress — this is NOT the Sulh Hukuk çağrı heyeti application.
Context: the 'mutlak butlan' (absolute nullity) ruling removed Özel and returned Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu to the CHP chairmanship, deepening the party split.

CHP Spokesperson Zeynel Emre announced the plan at a TBMM press conference (~July 13, 2026), saying they would file 'starting tomorrow'; some reporting cites a goal of holding the congress within 45 days.
